action_items: No functional issues. Optional: investigate pointerEvents deprecation source (library bump) when convenient.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py (~627 lines) remains manageable; LLM scoring + enrichment, feeds ingest, and HTTP routes are cleanly separated via feeds.py.
Startup wipe correctly removes any KI-SCOUT / DEMO-SEED legacy docs and any doc without source_url, matching the 'only real finds' requirement.
feeds.py uses httpx with timeout + User-Agent; dedupe via unique index on source_url and in-memory 'seen' set; parsing is defensive (try/except per item).
Scan concurrency guard uses asyncio.Lock → 409. Background poll runs every 10 min and shares the same lock — verified in test by waiting out the poller before racing a manual pair.
Image proxy correctly enforces https + allow-list hosts (static.mydealz.de / dealdoktor.de) and 400s all other hosts.
Pydantic GlitchDoc enforces tz-aware datetimes via field validators (no naïve datetime comparison regressions).

PRO buy buttons are rendered WITH prices but main agent explicitly stated they should be visually disabled while identity banner is up — not verified via DOM 'disabled' attribute in this run; worth a quick regression if that behaviour changes.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no new bugs found. Fixed earlier flake: concurrent-409 test was racing against the 10-min background poll; new test now waits up to 60s for the poll's lock to release before firing a tight thread race (0.05s offset) that reliably hits the 409 branch.
